title: Detailed motorbike
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <line x1='18' y1='64' x2='34' y2='80' stroke='#666688' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='34' y1='64' x2='18' y2='80' stroke='#666688' stroke-width='1'/>

  <line x1='26' y1='72' x2='48' y2='62' stroke='#4a4a6a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <line x1='40' y1='76' x2='58' y2='72' stroke='#aabbcc' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M46 49 Q54 41 62 43 Q66 45 65 50 L62 52 Q54 53 49 52 Z' fill='#ff6666'/>

  <!-- highlights -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='72' r='1.5' fill='#ddeeff'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='72' r='1.5' fill='#ddeeff'/>
</svg>
